# QR Code Integration with Logistics Module - Quick Reference

**Date**: November 12, 2024  
**Status**: Specification Complete  

---

## Overview

The Logistics Module **reuses the existing MO QR code system** - no changes to QR generation needed!

---

## Current QR Code System

### URL Structure

```
Format: https://[domain]/production/orders/{mo-number}/qr

Example: https://maintenance-os.com/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr
```

### Generated By

```php
// app/Services/Production/QrCodeService.php
QrCodeService::generateOrderUrl(ManufacturingOrder $order)
```

---

## URL Parsing

### Regex Pattern

```javascript
// Matches all these formats:
// - https://domain.com/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr
// - /production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr
// - /production/orders/MO-2024-0001

const pattern = /\/production\/orders\/([A-Z0-9-]+)(?:\/qr)?/i;
const match = qrContent.match(pattern);
const moNumber = match[1]; // "MO-2024-0001"
```

### Supported Formats

| Input | Parsed Result |
|-------|---------------|
| `https://app.com/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr` | `MO-2024-0001` |
| `/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr` | `MO-2024-0001` |
| `/production/orders/MO-2024-0001` | `MO-2024-0001` |
| `MO-2024-0001` | `MO-2024-0001` |

---

## Backend Implementation

### QrParsingService

```php
// app/Services/Logistics/QrParsingService.php

public function parseMoNumberFromQr(string $qrContent): ?string
{
    $pattern = '/\/production\/orders\/([A-Z0-9-]+)(?:\/qr)?/i';
    
    if (preg_match($pattern, $qrContent, $matches)) {
        return $matches[1]; // MO-2024-0001
    }
    
    // Fallback: direct MO number
    if (preg_match('/^MO-\d{4}-\d+$/i', $qrContent)) {
        return strtoupper($qrContent);
    }
    
    return null;
}

public function findMoFromQr(string $qrContent): ?ManufacturingOrder
{
    $moNumber = $this->parseMoNumberFromQr($qrContent);
    return ManufacturingOrder::where('order_number', $moNumber)->first();
}

public function validateQrForShipment(string $qrContent, int $shipmentId): array
{
    $mo = $this->findMoFromQr($qrContent);
    
    // Check if MO is in this shipment
    $shipmentItem = ShipmentItem::where('shipment_id', $shipmentId)
        ->where('manufacturing_order_id', $mo->id)
        ->first();
    
    return [
        'valid' => (bool) $shipmentItem,
        'mo' => $mo,
        'shipment_item' => $shipmentItem,
    ];
}
```

### Controller Endpoint

```php
// app/Http/Controllers/Logistics/ShipmentController.php

public function findMoFromQr(string $moNumber)
{
    $mo = ManufacturingOrder::where('order_number', $moNumber)
        ->with([
            'item',
            'manufacturingRoute.steps' => fn($q) => 
                $q->where('execution_location', 'external')
                  ->where('external_status', 'awaiting_shipment')
        ])
        ->first();
    
    if (!$mo) {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'MO not found'], 404);
    }
    
    return response()->json([
        'mo' => $mo,
        'has_external_steps_awaiting_shipment' => 
            $mo->manufacturingRoute?->steps->isNotEmpty(),
        'external_steps' => $mo->manufacturingRoute?->steps,
    ]);
}
```

**Route:**
```php
Route::get('shipments/find-mo/{mo_number}', [ShipmentController::class, 'findMoFromQr'])
    ->name('shipments.find-mo');
```

## Frontend Implementation

### QR Scanner Component

```typescript
// resources/js/components/logistics/QrScanner.tsx

export function QrScanner({ onScan }: { onScan: (moNumber: string) => void }) {
    const parseMoNumber = (qrContent: string): string | null => {
        const pattern = /\/production\/orders\/([A-Z0-9-]+)(?:\/qr)?/i;
        const match = qrContent.match(pattern);
        
        if (match) return match[1];
        
        // Direct MO number
        if (/^MO-\d{4}-\d+$/i.test(qrContent)) {
            return qrContent.toUpperCase();
        }
        
        return null;
    };
    
    const handleScan = (decodedText: string) => {
        const moNumber = parseMoNumber(decodedText);
        
        if (moNumber) {
            onScan(moNumber);
        } else {
            alert('QR Code inválido');
        }
    };
    
    // Use html5-qrcode library for scanning
    const startScanner = () => {
        const scanner = new Html5QrcodeScanner('qr-reader', {
            fps: 10,
            qrbox: { width: 250, height: 250 },
        });
        
        scanner.render(handleScan);
    };
    
    return (
        <div>
            <Button onClick={startScanner}>
                Escanear QR Code
            </Button>
            <div id="qr-reader" />
            
            {/* Manual fallback */}
            <Input 
                placeholder="Ou digite: MO-2024-0001"
                onEnter={(value) => {
                    const moNumber = parseMoNumber(value);
                    if (moNumber) onScan(moNumber);
                }}
            />
        </div>
    );
}
```

### Usage in Shipment Creation

```typescript
// resources/js/pages/logistics/shipments/create.tsx

export default function CreateShipment() {
    const [selectedMos, setSelectedMos] = useState<MO[]>([]);
    
    const handleQrScan = async (moNumber: string) => {
        try {
            const { data } = await axios.get(
                route('shipments.find-mo', { mo_number: moNumber })
            );
            
            if (!data.has_external_steps_awaiting_shipment) {
                toast.error('Esta OM não possui etapas aguardando envio');
                return;
            }
            
            if (selectedMos.some(m => m.order_number === moNumber)) {
                toast.warning('OM já adicionada');
                return;
            }
            
            setSelectedMos([...selectedMos, data.mo]);
            toast.success(`OM ${moNumber} adicionada`);
            
        } catch (error) {
            toast.error('Erro ao buscar OM');
        }
    };
    
    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Escanear OMs</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
                <QrScanner onScan={handleQrScan} />
                
                {/* Show selected MOs */}
                <div className="mt-4">
                    {selectedMos.map(mo => (
                        <div key={mo.id}>
                            ✓ {mo.order_number} - {mo.item?.name}
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}
```

## Packing List QR Codes

### Include QR Codes on Packing Lists

```blade
<!-- resources/views/pdf/packing-list.blade.php -->

<table>
    <thead>
        <tr>
            <th>MO</th>
            <th>Item</th>
            <th>Quantity</th>
            <th>QR Code</th>
        </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
        @foreach($items as $item)
        <tr>
            <td>{{ $item['order_number'] }}</td>
            <td>{{ $item['item_name'] }}</td>
            <td>{{ $item['quantity'] }}</td>
            <td>
                <img src="data:image/png;base64,{{ $item['qr_code_base64'] }}" 
                     width="80" 
                     height="80" />
            </td>
        </tr>
        @endforeach
    </tbody>
</table>
```

### Generate QR Codes for Packing List

```php
// app/Services/Logistics/PackingListService.php

public function getPackingListData(Shipment $shipment): array
{
    $qrCodeService = app(QrCodeService::class);
    
    $items = $shipment->items->map(function ($item) use ($qrCodeService) {
        $url = $qrCodeService->generateOrderUrl($item->manufacturingOrder);
        $qrCode = $qrCodeService->generateQrCode($url, ['size' => 200]);
        
        return [
            'order_number' => $item->manufacturingOrder->order_number,
            'item_name' => $item->item_name,
            'quantity' => $item->quantity_shipped,
            'qr_code_base64' => base64_encode($qrCode),
        ];
    });
    
    return [
        'shipment_number' => $shipment->shipment_number,
        'items' => $items,
        // ... other data
    ];
}
```

## Benefits

| Benefit | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| ✅ **No Duplication** | Reuse existing QR system, no new QR generation needed |
| ✅ **Consistency** | Same QR codes used across production and logistics |
| ✅ **Mobile Ready** | Existing QR system already mobile-optimized |
| ✅ **Simple Parsing** | Extract MO number with simple regex |
| ✅ **Fallback** | Manual MO number entry always available |
| ✅ **No DB Changes** | QR codes already exist for all MOs |
| ✅ **Familiar UX** | Users already know how MO QR codes work |

## Testing Checklist

### QR Parsing Tests

```php
/** @test */
public function parses_mo_number_from_full_url()
{
    $service = new QrParsingService();
    $url = 'https://app.com/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr';
    
    $result = $service->parseMoNumberFromQr($url);
    
    $this->assertEquals('MO-2024-0001', $result);
}

/** @test */
public function parses_mo_number_from_relative_path()
{
    $service = new QrParsingService();
    $path = '/production/orders/MO-2024-0001/qr';
    
    $result = $service->parseMoNumberFromQr($path);
    
    $this->assertEquals('MO-2024-0001', $result);
}

/** @test */
public function parses_direct_mo_number()
{
    $service = new QrParsingService();
    
    $result = $service->parseMoNumberFromQr('MO-2024-0001');
    
    $this->assertEquals('MO-2024-0001', $result);
}

/** @test */
public function validates_qr_belongs_to_shipment()
{
    $shipment = Shipment::factory()->create();
    $mo = ManufacturingOrder::factory()->create(['order_number' => 'MO-2024-0001']);
    
    ShipmentItem::factory()->create([
        'shipment_id' => $shipment->id,
        'manufacturing_order_id' => $mo->id,
    ]);
    
    $service = new QrParsingService();
    $result = $service->validateQrForShipment('MO-2024-0001', $shipment->id);
    
    $this->assertTrue($result['valid']);
    $this->assertEquals($mo->id, $result['mo']->id);
}
```

npm install html5-qrcode
